 Keith Demko, Salisbury Daily Times Tue, November 3, 2026 at 10:02 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Maryland First District election results: Harris vs. Schwartz Republican Rep. Andy Harris has never lost an election in the First District he represents since first being elected to Congress in 2011.
 Will this year be any different?
 In Maryland's 2026 Gubernatorial Election, Harris is being challenged by Democrat Dan Schwartz.
 Follow along for updates on this race throughou election day, and for the results as they come in after the polls close at 8 p.m.
